summary.text: Jessica Grill is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 18 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary.
Grill works in advertising, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Grill was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and earned a B.S. in psychology, magna cum laude, from Northeastern University in 2018.
Her career experience includes working in advertising as a marketing associate, assistant strategist, and media coordinator and supervisor.
Grill won the general election for Hillsborough 18 on November 8, 2022, and was re-elected on November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Election Law Committee, where she served as clerk.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Grill listed three campaign messages: expanding the state's economic potential through business development and investment, modernizing infrastructure with a focus on sustainable technology and transportation options, and protecting natural resources.
In the same survey, she said she would work to defend bodily autonomy, voting rights and free speech.
